title: A Rainy Day
description: A girl finds fun things to do on a rainy day.
instructions: Read the text about a rainy day, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: Yesterday was a rainy day. Mia could not play in the garden. She stood at the window and looked at the grey sky.
Her dad had an idea. They made a little house with chairs and blankets in the living room. Mia read books inside it with a torch.
In the afternoon, the rain stopped. Mia put on her red boots. She jumped in the big puddles outside. Her boots got very wet, but she laughed.

Next, Mia looked up at the sky. She saw a big rainbow over the houses. It had many colours. Mia ran inside and called her dad. 'Dad, come and look!' she said. They stood in the garden and looked at it together.
Mia's boots and socks were very wet. Her feet were cold. Her dad said, 'Take them off, please.' He put her boots near the door. Then Mia put on dry socks and a warm pink jumper.
Then they made hot chocolate in the kitchen. Mia put three marshmallows in her cup. They sat on the sofa and drank it. Outside, it started to rain again, but Mia did not mind.
In the evening, Mia drew a picture of the rainbow for her mum. Her mum came home from work at six o'clock. She loved the picture and put it on the fridge. Mia said, 'I like rainy days now!'
